result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. That matches the sales rep list. Closed tickets and other regions' tickets are still excluded.

I changed `listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` in `DataStore.java`. Its `ORDER BY` now uses the same `CASE t.priority …` expression as `listOpenSupportTicketsBySalesRep`, and I updated the javadoc to match.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='Region*,DemoScenarioTest'` and it exited 0. I did not add a test for your T-1 to T-5 example, so the new ordering isn't covered by a test. I did not commit anything.
